title: Sr. Software Architect - AI
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
Join Ericsson as a Senior Software Architect – AI, owning end-to-end architecture for enterprise-scale GenAI and AI-powered solutions within our Self-Service Platform (SSP). You will design scalable, secure, production-grade AI platforms leveraging agentic frameworks, LLMs, and cloud-native services. You will establish reference architectures across RAG, memory, evaluation, and observability while guiding teams across the full model lifecycle — at the intersection of AI innovation and Responsible AI governance.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Architect agentic AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, and orchestration patterns; define prompt strategies, guardrails, and structured outputs aligned to product and risk requirements.
* Design and optimize RAG solutions (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking) and own foundation model integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, on-prem LLMs) with routing, fallbacks, and cost/performance optimization.
* Define GenAI reference architectures; evaluate and select LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks based on performance, compliance, and cost.
* Embed security, privacy, and Responsible AI governance from inception — covering PII handling, data access controls, and content guardrails.
* Build scalable backend APIs using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) with REST/JSON-RPC interfaces and resilience patterns (Redis, RabbitMQ); guide teams on MLOps/LLMOps standards including deployment, monitoring, retraining, and drift handling.
* Define LLM evaluation strategies, implement observability/tracing (Arize, LangSmith), and design memory strategies with retention and replay safety for long-running assistants.
* Containerize and deploy services via Docker and Kubernetes; govern CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scanning, and IaC (Terraform or equivalent).

**The skills you bring:**

* BE/B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent, with 15+ years in software architecture and relevant 3+ years designing AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”
* Deep expertise in Python (FastAPI, asyncio) and ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow); strong experience with distributed, cloud-native services.
* Hands-on with RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases (Elastic, Pinecone, Milvus, Chroma) for enterprise knowledge grounding.
* Hands on Python experience mandatory
* Proven experience with agentic GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) and interoperability patterns such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong knowledge of LLM architectures, fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT), and experience with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock.
* Solid understanding of MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI principles, and embedding governance into GenAI design. Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD for cloud-native AI deployments.
* Good to Have: LLM observability tools (Arize, LangSmith), Azure enterprise services (AKS, Key Vault), memory frameworks (MemGPT, LangMem), knowledge graph experience, and Telecom industry AI adoption background.
* Locations: Bangalore, Kolkata, Gurgaon, Noida, Chennai

**Why join Ericsson?**
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models : you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for : QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams : technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication : you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft : you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer :
  
  

* A people-first culture : supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands & possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.

* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.

**Professional understanding & knowledge of-**

* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. **Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering**

* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.

* Overall experience: 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery.
* Java/J2EE depth: 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience.
* Architecture depth: 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture.
* AI delivery: 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery.
* Leadership: Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes.
* Consulting: Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Capability & Expected proficiency**

* Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
* GenAI and agentic AI - LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
* AI frameworks - Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
* Data and retrieval - SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j
* Cloud AI - At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
* Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support

title: Workday Integrations/Studio Consulting (Global Delivery Center)
description:
**About The Team**
The Cognizant Workday Practice Global Delivery Center is growing across all skill levels and Workday functional areas —and this is your chance to be part of it!
  
  
Join a dynamic team where you’ll work with exciting clients, expand your Workday skills, and take advantage of engagement opportunities that keep you connected and inspired. If you’re ready to grow your career in a collaborative, innovative environment, we’d love to have you on board.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a part of the Workday Integrations team, you’ll serve as the Workday expert with knowledge of design, configuration, testing, and deployment. You’ll independently be managing work on multiple projects in various phases and conducting sessions with customers to analyse their business requirements. You’ll be leveraging your expertise to provide recommendations and develop solutions for our customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with key business and IT stakeholders to confirm requirements, consider design alternatives, facilitate discussions, and ultimately drive requirements sign-off.
* Evaluate, communicate, and coordinate the technical impacts of application configuration decisions.
* Create detailed system interface specifications, field mapping, and system process designs following CS Methodology.
* Facilitating design workshops with customers for AMS and Implementations projects.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy integrations required to meet business requirements.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer and educate clients on developing and operating interfaces to and from a SaaS platform.
* Track issues and risks, communication status and escalate concerns to project management.
* Review solution architectures and components to analyze client requirements for integration processes and ensure adherence to same.

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Computer/Telecommunication Engineering or equivalent
* Active Workday Certifications in Workday Integration and Studio and specialized areas highly preferred
* Experience in different aspects of Workday Integrations such as WD APIs, EIB, Connectors, Document Transformations, Workday Studio, and Workday CCTPPTM
* Project experience in a technical or techno-functional role on one or more ERP implementation and post go-live projects
* 3+ years of experience working in Integration.
* Demonstrated proficiency with web service technologies (REST, JSON, SOAP, HTTP, SSL, PGP, SAML, etc.,)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication capabilities; able to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
* Superior detail orientation, organization, and analytical skills
* Outstanding Microsoft Excel skills
* Thrive on simultaneously operating at multiple levels and managing multiple responsibilities
* Ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, growing ecosystem with minimal supervision
* Must be flexible to work in-office 3 days per week

* Good understanding of Access Management and CIAM solutions.

* Hands-on experience on Okta APIs.
* Should be knowledge on Okta Access Gateway, Okta Advance Server Access and SCIM.
* Hands-on experience on developing custom UI pages, branding and email template as per business needs.
* Should be familiar with the RBAC, ABAC, User provisioning, data synchronization, password management and IAM governance with AM tools such as Okta.
* Strong understanding of access management fundamentals like SSO, authentication and authorization.
* Good hands-on experience on OAuth 2.0, OIDC, WS-Fed protocols.
* Define and set up approach for risk-based MFA and applications access control.
* Hands-on experience on security related assessments and configuration for AM platforms, adaptive risk configurations and Multi-factor authentications.
* Capability of understanding the business requirements and converting that into design.
* Ability to perform risk assessment and threat modelling exercises with technology engineering teams.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Worked in client facing role.
* Need to be thorough in their respective tool with hands-on experience involving configuration, implementation & customization.
* Hands-on Java/Python development and debugging experience.
* Use case design, Solution Requirements Specification and mapping business requirements to technical requirements (Traceability Matrix).
* Architecture Design (optimising the resources made available – servers and load sharing etc).
* Involvement in a successful pursuit of a potential client by being part of the RFP response team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Experience Access Management tools such as Okta, PingFed
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-8 Years’ Work Experience

**Security Analyst – IAM (Okta)**

* Very good understanding of information security concepts with in-depth knowledge of IAM solutions and latest trends.
* Should be able to understand business requirement and translate them in technical requirement and implement the same.
* Experience in installation, configuration, deployment, and implementation on Okta tool.
* Experience over integration of on-prem and legacy applications with Okta.
* Good understanding of federation protocols like SAML2.0, OAuth, OIDC, WS-Fed, SWA
* Working knowledge on multi-factor authentication, Security Rules, Policies and Provisioning.
* Hands-on experience in troubleshooting the issues related with Okta and any other AM specific tools.
* Scripting knowledge in Python Unix Shell scripting.

* Experience in Directory Integration with Okta.

* Customer orientation skills

* Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events.

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

**The opportunity**
We’re looking for SMRs at Manager/Senior rank with expertise in
**Business Analysis/Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)**
to join the P&U Sector group of GDS Consulting Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse, understand and document client needs from a Business perspective and work with the client to arrive at optimal solutions leveraging the experience and expertise in OT/Control systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)
* Identify and implement business process re-design and continuous improvements, working closely with Clients, Operations teams, and other business areas

* Identify integration needs with any other in house/third party systems and provide detailed information about these systems to Solution Architects as well as Technical Team

* Ability to assess Value Potential of a Transmission & Distribution transformation program and ability to architect the value proposal
* Identify and develop commercialization solutions with substantial growth potential for power distribution clients, and provide advisory services to clients

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding and experience with the electric utility industry, including knowledge of Grid Operations, Field Operations, Smart Grids and Digital Grid
* Deliver large/medium P&U Sector specific solutions/OT (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) as well as Control Systems
* Demonstrate expert core consulting skills and advanced level of OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) knowledge and industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Understanding Distributed Energy Resources or related experience in clean energy, energy efficiency, storage and solar
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
* Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements
* Programme management experience and track record of successful delivery of large, complex programmes
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
* Be result oriented as well as people focused
* Be able to manage a team, empathetic and work with Leadership for the development of the overall team

**Professionals in this role are expected to bring expertise in emerging technologies and advanced solutions that enable utilities to thrive in a digital, sustainable future. These include:**

* AMI 2.0 and Advanced Metering Infrastructure: Next-generation metering systems that go beyond traditional AMI, enabling real-time data collection, advanced analytics, and integration with distributed energy resources for improved grid visibility and customer engagement.
* Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS): Knowledge of energy storage technologies and their role in grid stability, peak load management, and renewable integration. Ability to assess and design BESS solutions for operational efficiency and resilience.
* Digital Twin Technologies: Experience in creating virtual replicas of physical assets and systems to simulate, monitor, and optimise grid operations, predictive maintenance, and scenario planning.
* Geographic Information Systems (GIS): Proficiency in GIS platforms for spatial analysis, asset mapping, and network planning to enhance operational decision-making and outage management.
* System Integration and Architecture Design: Capability to design robust integration frameworks and architectures that connect OT systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, SCADA) with IT platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.
* Smart Control Centre Solutions: Expertise in modern control centre technologies that enable real-time monitoring, automation, and advanced decision support for grid operations and distributed energy management.
* Vegetation Management Tools and Strategies: Familiarity with digital tools and predictive analytics for vegetation monitoring and clearance planning to reduce outage risks and improve reliability.

* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation /Technical advisory with total experience between 10 to 15 years (for Manager)
* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation/Technical advisory with total experience between 6 to 10 years (for Senior)
* Should be well versed with functional concepts of BA with relevant knowledge in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) and Gap analysis
* Should be well conversant in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA), products/technologies, frameworks, business metadata management and relevant architectural components.
* Strong business analysis skills
* Strong command over business process design

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good Business Writing skills
* Good Communication skills
* Maintaining end-to-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
* Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
* Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution

**Qualification And Experience Required -**

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
* Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
* SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
* SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
* Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
* Proven delivery experience with:
* RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
* CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
* OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
* Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
* Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
* Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).

* Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

description:

Role Details:

• Role: SAP IS-U CRM Technical Consultant

• Position Type: Contingent Worker

• Work Hours: 45 hours per week

• Experience: 6 to 8 Years

• Location: Pan-India (Major Metro Cities)

• Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days max

What you will be working on:

• Designing, developing, and customizing technical solutions for SAP IS-Utilities (IS-U) integrated with SAP CRM.

• Enhancing and customizing SAP CRM Web Client UI (Web UI), Component Workbench, BOL/GENIL layers, and business roles for utilities processes.

• Developing and extending ABAP/OO-ABAP programs, BAdIs, User Exits, Enhancement Points, and BAPIs within IS-U and CRM systems.

• Managing and troubleshooting CRM Middleware replication, BDocs, queues (SMQ1/SMQ2), and master data synchronization between SAP IS-U (ECC/S4) and CRM.

• Designing and integrating REST/SOAP web services, OData APIs, and IDocs for third-party and portal integrations.

• Conducting performance tuning, code optimization, SQL trace (ST05), and debugging complex runtime issues.

• Collaborating with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders during testing (SIT/UAT), cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.

• 6 to 8 years of solid technical development experience in SAP IS-U CRM.

• Strong hands-on expertise in SAP CRM Web UI architecture (Component Workbench, BOL, GENIL, Context Nodes).

• Deep understanding of CRM Middleware configuration, replication monitoring, and BDoc error resolution with backend IS-U.

• Strong proficiency in Core ABAP, OO-ABAP, Enhancement Framework, and RFC/BAPI interfaces.

• Solid technical grasp of utilities domain flows (Customer Service, Move-In/Move-Out, Contract Accounts, Meter-to-Cash).

• Experience developing and consuming OData services, CDS views, or RESTful APIs is an added advantage.

* • Strong analytical debugging, problem-solving, and cross-functional technical communication skills.

Optimize architectures for reusability, maintainability, performance, and deployment efficiency.

Improve engineering productivity through automation and reusable development assets.
  
  
Client Engagement & Collaboration

Drive AI product innovation, reusable asset development, and engineering best practices.

* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.

* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.

* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.

* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.

Master's Degree

As a Senior Manager/Specialist leader at Deloitte Consulting, you will play the role of strategic architect who creates and(or) reviews enterprise grade architectures and also provides best practices for technical delivery for complex, enterprise-solutions. * Contributions to thought leadership through patents, publications, speaking engagements, or technical blogs

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI**

Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary

, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a

Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.
  
  
This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.
  
  
As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization**

* Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.
* Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.
* Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.
* Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).
* Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.
* Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

**Data & AI Infrastructure**

* Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.
* Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.
* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

**Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture**

* Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.
* Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.
* Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

**GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy**

* You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.
* You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.
* Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

**Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership**

* Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.
* Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.
* Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.
* Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.
* Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.
* System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.
* Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.
* Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.
* Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.
* Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.
* Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).
* Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.
* Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.
* Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.
* Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

**Why Join Us?**

* Impact at scale—we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges.
* Modern technical foundation with room to innovate—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Hands-on architecture leadership—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.
* Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts, pushing the limits of what’s possible.
* Competitive compensation and high ownership—your work will define how Jumio scales.

**Jumio Values:**
IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
**:**
Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.
  
  
**About Jumio:**
Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.
  
  
Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data-to-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.

description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, AMPScript, JS/SSJS, HTML, CSS, SQL, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies. You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points.
  
  
You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 4-5 years on the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Personalization, Marketing Cloud Insights, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Data Cloud and Agent Force. Moderate experience with Sales, Service, Community, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

title: Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as an architect for data and analytics solutions built on Databricks platforms designing scalable pipelines and frameworks that leverage Databricks SQL Databricks Workflows and PySpark. Apply extensive experience to optimize hybrid day shift delivery enable reliable insights for stakeholders and support innovation in insurance focused business environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design robust data architecture on Databricks platforms that aligns with enterprise standards and enables secure scalable analytics across hybrid work environments
* Develop end to end data pipelines using PySpark and Databricks Workflows that transform complex raw data into curated datasets ready for business consumption
* Optimize Databricks SQL queries and data models to improve performance reduce compute cost and ensure consistent response times for analytical workloads
* Create reusable frameworks and patterns for ingestion transformation and data quality that can be adopted by engineering teams across multiple initiatives
* Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate analytical and reporting needs into well defined data architecture and implementation plans
* Integrate data from diverse source systems into unified models that support actuarial analysis financial reporting and operational monitoring for insurance focused solutions
* Define standards for coding testing and documentation of PySpark jobs and Databricks assets to promote maintainability and long term platform resilience
* Implement monitoring and alerting strategies on Databricks Workflows to ensure timely detection of pipeline failures and to support reliable data delivery in day shift operations
* Partner with security and compliance teams to embed data governance privacy controls and audit readiness into all Databricks based solutions
* Guide teams on efficient use of Databricks clusters storage and caching options to balance performance objectives with infrastructure cost management
* Document architectural decisions data flows and dependency maps so that teams can easily understand solution design and support future enhancements
* Coordinate with cross functional teams in a hybrid work model to plan releases manage dependencies and ensure smooth deployment of new data capabilities

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience in Databricks SQL to design analytical models reporting layers and interactive queries that support complex business insights
* Leverage advanced proficiency in Databricks Workflows to orchestrate jobs manage dependencies and automate data operations with strong reliability
* Utilize deep PySpark expertise to implement scalable transformations handle large data volumes and enforce data quality rules across the pipeline lifecycle
* Draw on knowledge of life and annuities insurance to shape data models metrics and validations that reflect key policy claim and risk concepts when required
* Demonstrate proven ability gained from twelve to sixteen years of experience in data engineering and architecture to handle complex enterprise grade solutions
* Apply strong communication and collaboration capabilities to work effectively with business and technology partners in a hybrid non travel environment
* Use experience with modern data platforms and cloud ecosystems to integrate Databricks solutions into broader enterprise architectures for long term value

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate.
